description: Numeric summaries only. Original transcripts/audio/embeddings remain in remote test evidence; hashes permit verification.
quality_reference: no human annotation, no CUDA golden; output statistics do not prove recognition, diarization or emotion accuracy

observed_metrics.scope: 5s sampling; maxima may miss transient peaks; shared card/host, not exclusive capacity

main_cpu_percent_one_core_100.scope: main service process only; excludes VAD workers and shared processes
